Title: Eskerland chemicals makers count cost of port strike
Outlet: Runewire
Publication Date: 2025-05-13
Source Type: news_report
Event ID: EVT-B
Country: Eskerland
Sector: chemicals
Reliability Tier: 2

About 40 percent of Eskerland's chemicals exports leave through Eskhaven, industry figures show.

Eskhaven Chemworks said it had stopped two production lines.
